title: Case: Severe weather suspends the delivery route
context: An operator weather decision suspends the route. The correct task is to relay a verified update and review time, not invent a replacement arrival estimate.
initial_request: I saw the weather alert. Can you tell me whether my parcel is coming today and when I should expect an update?

events.from: Route safety control, Brindleworth Arc Logistics
events.body: Route MQ-19 is suspended due to severe weather. DL-8149 is secure in depot stock. Dispatch will review conditions at 15:00 UTC today; there is no approved delivery estimate.
I saw the weather alert. Can you tell me whether my parcel is coming today and when I should expect an update?
Please provide the approved disruption wording and next review time for DL-8149. I need a verified customer update, not an unapproved arrival estimate.
FYI only, no action needed from the desk: we have this in hand and will update the customer directly. Nothing further is required from you on this one.

must_not: Sends another message to Dispatch, Brindleworth Arc Logistics restating the request already sent
Sends the customer a new promise, date or outcome that nobody has confirmed
A review time is not a route-restart time or guaranteed delivery time.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-019: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. The desk's correct action was already sent (event 3) and the last message is an acknowledgement or FYI with no request, so nothing is owed.
